keys._comment: Registry of all keys this project uses, where they live, and what they're for.

keystore._comment: Credentials stored in OS keystore (service='locke'). Retrieved via locke keystore get.

encryptedConfig._comment: Keys inside the encrypted config file. Flattened to SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE env vars at runtime.

vault._comment: Per-developer secrets in Vaultwarden. Path format: {project}/{tenant}/{name}.
vault.{project}/{tenant}/personal_api_key: Personal API key for external service

env._comment: Plain environment variables (non-secret config). Set in .env or deployment.
